EAM Jaishankar to Visit Russia for Bilateral Commission Meeting

External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar is scheduled to visit Russia to co-chair the 13th India-Russia Intergovernmental Commission on Military-Technical Cooperation. The visit comes amid a global context where former US President Donald Trump has threatened tariffs on countries trading with the US. The specific dates of the visit were not provided in the coverage.
